metadata.intro: Quickly measure your ability to deploy with this free assessment. On the results page, you’ll find your deployment score and relevant improvement ideas. We recommend your team complete the assessment together as the conversation is a valuable as the result.
metadata.feedback_message: Thank you for using our deployment capability assessment! We hope you found it valuable.  While you're here, we'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback to help us improve this tool.

metadata.advice_intro: The following recommendations have been prioritized based on your unique score. The most impactful items appear first.
metadata.congrats_message: You have achieved maximum scores across all categories! Your deployment capability is well formed and follows industry best practices. Maintain this level of excellence and keep exploring new ways to innovate.

categories.name: Deployers
categories.advice: A key finding in our research was that efficiency savings were hard to achieve when a single person was responsible for deployments. This was even the case after automating deployments. A team shouldn't depend on one person for deployments. By sharing the responsibility, you'll find your documentation and process improve, and bottlenecks are less likely.

questions.text: For the application in question, how many people can trigger a Production deployment?
questions.description: Triggering a deployment includes someone instructing a deployment, push-button deployments, or commit-triggered deployments.
questions.advice: Find and train additional deployers to spread the workload. Create a team that can look at improving the deployment process.

categories.name: Throughput
categories.advice:
When you deploy more often, you reduce deployment risk, increase quality, and get feedback sooner. The longer you leave between deployments, the more change builds up.

Long deployment lead times are usually caused by manual steps, or an approval process that holds up the deployment. If you can reduce your lead times, you'll likely increase your deployment frequency. Short lead times also make it easier to recover by rolling forward to a new version with a fix, or to roll back to the previous version.

questions.text: For the application in question, how often do you typically deploy to Production?
questions.advice: Reduce batch sizes to increase deployment frequency. Research has found this increases software delivery performance.

questions.text: For the application in question, how long does it take for a change to move from approved (merged) to Production?
questions.advice: Map your deployment pipeline. Identify queues, blockers, and long-running tasks that you can target to reduce the time to complete a deployment.

categories.name: Automation
categories.advice: You won't be surprised that we think you should automate deployments. Our deployment survey found that after introducing Octopus, our customers were 2.5x more likely to deploy on demand and 4.7x more likely to deploy in under an hour. Automated deployments are just faster and more frequent. The process is safer and more reliable.

questions.text: For the application in question, how automated are your software deployments?
questions.advice: Identify manual steps in the deployment process and find ways to reduce manual intervention.

options.level: Manual: The deployment is mostly a manual process.
Partly automated: Parts of the process are automated, such as scripts that can be triggered to perform application deployment tasks.
Fully automated: The application deployment process needs no manual intervention apart from push-button approvals.

questions.text: For the application in question, how automated are your database deployments?
questions.advice: Automate your database deployments to make updates safer and to keep different environments in sync.

options.level: Manual: The database deployment is mostly a manual process.
Partly automated: Parts of the process are automated, such as scripts that can be triggered to perform database deployment tasks.
Fully automated: The database deployment process needs no manual intervention apart from push-button approvals.
